title: Engagement of Independent Engineer for the project - Development of tourism at Mahabalipuram Lighthouse on PPP basis.
summary: E-tender (two-cover) inviting TIDB Panel-10 empanelled consultants to act as Independent Engineer for the DBFOT PPP project for tourism development (approx. Rs 6 crore) at Mahabalipuram Lighthouse, Chengalpattu District, Tamil Nadu (Chennai Directorate).

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai

sites.name: Mahabalipuram Lighthouse, Chengalpattu District, Tamil Nadu
sites.work: Independent Engineer for DBFOT tourism development project

scope.item: Engagement of Independent Engineer for the project - Development of tourism at Mahabalipuram Lighthouse on PPP (DBFOT) basis

money.notes: Tentative project cost of the underlying DBFOT project Rs 6.00 crores approx. (not the consultancy estimate). EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai, payable at Chennai, valid three months from technical bid opening. No tender fee.

period.completion: 14 months (tentative) from Appointed Date: 08 months for minimum development obligations and restaurant/cafeteria operation + 06 months from commercial operations
period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Consultants empanelled with Tamil Nadu Industrial Development Board under Panel no. 10 with engineering consultancy experience as Independent Engineer for PPP projects

Similar assignments in last seven years (IE or PMC/engineering consultancy for PPP tourism, hospitality and recreational infrastructure): one project with capital cost >= Rs 4.80 crore, or two >= Rs 3.00 crore, or three >= Rs 2.40 crore (excluding land)
Average annual turnover from professional fees/engineering consultancy >= Rs 5.4 lakh in last 3 financial years ending 31 March 2023
P&L statement and audited balance sheet for past five years ending 31 March 2023; ITRs and sales tax clearance for last three years

Litigation/blacklisting information for last 5 years; key personnel details; unconditional bid undertaking (Annexure III); tender acceptance letter (Annexure II); non-blacklisting affidavit; relatives declaration; Section VI technical evaluation documents
notes: Section I NIT only (printed pages 1, 3, 4; page 2 not in PDF). Download/submission 13.05.2024 10:00 to 04.06.2024 15:00; pre-bid 27.05.2024 15:00; EMD original by 03.06.2024 15:00, a day before bid submission end; opening 05.06.2024 15:00. Eligibility clause oddly says experience certificates from an officer 'not below' Executive Engineer rank shall not be considered (likely a drafting error). CPPP digital signature dated 10.05.2024 (signer name not transcribed).
